description: OpenVids grants the webview control over its own window only. The window loads http://127.0.0.1 pages (the Projects home and Studio) — remote origins as far as Tauri is concerned — and the pages draw their own titlebars over the window frame: on macOS the overlay titlebar keeps the native traffic lights, so the pages mark their titlebars with data-tauri-drag-region and need start_dragging (plus internal_toggle_maximize for the double-click zoom); on Windows the window is frameless and the pages also draw minimize / maximize / close, which need minimize, toggle_maximize, close and reading is_maximized for the restore icon. Nothing else: every file read, write, upload and delete already goes through the home and Studio HTTP APIs, which run in Rust or the sidecar with full OS access.
